verdict.rationale: Framer's docs show responsive design work: the canvas lets designers refine layouts, breakpoints and spacing, and the agent adapts layouts across tablet and phone breakpoints by adjusting stacks, type sizes and spacing. Grid layouts appear only as an agent prompt example. Constraints, and how frames actually resize and flex, are never documented directly, and most of the evidence is AI-agent framing rather than manual layout primitives. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of auto-layout/stack behavior, resizing constraints (pinning, fill/fixed sizing), layout grids as a canvas feature, and independent or hands-on corroboration of responsive frame behavior.
